title: Kenyan Sardine Skewers with Fried Velvety Sauce
description: A fusion twist on traditional Chinese cuisine, this recipe combines the bold flavors of Kenya with the comforting taste of sardines. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Thread sardine mixture onto bamboo skewers.
Brush skewers with sesame oil and season with Kenyan seasoning blend.
Grill skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix fried shallots and velvety sauce in a small bowl.
Serve sardine skewers with fried velvety sauce and garnish with chopped cilantro and lemon wedges.
Drizzle with soy sauce and serve immediately.
